lines.3: 「Accept you? Even her parent approves. You would not listen to me regardless.」
lines.4: I never even noticed Otome came home yesterday.
lines.7: Nagomi stares at Otome in displeasure.
lines.15: 「In any case, now that I am back, you will not do whatever you please!」
lines.17: Nagomi fixes Otome with a fierce glare.
lines.18: Nagomi, you fool. You picked the wrong opponent.
lines.20: Even Nagomi falters slightly before that stare.
lines.23: 「...That is what I would like to say, but...」
lines.25: 「The house is perfectly clean, and Leo is in excellent health. I thank you for taking care of those things.」
lines.26: 「Even so, without my supervision, there is no telling what youthful impulse will make you do.」
lines.27: 「So, I will live here Monday through Friday and return to my family home on weekends.」
lines.29: 「Keep your recreation to the holidays. At all other times, fulfill your duties as students. Agreed?」
lines.31: I think that is the greatest concession Otome can make.
